component: Apache Arrow Gandiva scalar execution extension
notes: Minimal visitor integration patch plus an independent scalar code generation extension. The owning runtime and query cache are zvec code under src/db/sqlengine/scalar_jit.
local_changes: Expose read-only Annotator metadata and let ScalarGenerator reuse the expression visitor through a compile-time scalar context.
Keep the scalar entry point, parameter metadata, raw buffer binding and intermediate validity handling in separate extension sources.
Preserve LLVMGenerator's existing instance state and public API; batch visitors use the default null context.
Observe emitted object-code size only on scalar engines without retaining an additional object copy.
